cultural_guidance.heading: Achaeans
source_summary: External forms favour curves, onion domes and occasional slender tower elements.
Interiors are highly decorated and crowded, with low barrel vaults and textile furnishings.
Comfort matters even where Terran observers dislike the visual excess.
authoring_interpretation: Use curved silhouettes, supported dome profiles and inhabited complexity when relevant to the reference.
Do not add domes, towers or interior furnishings indiscriminately to small vehicles.
cultural_guidance.scope: Direct evidence for architecture; vehicle/ship application is contextual extrapolation, never recovered geometry.
